path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": null, "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "preamble": "preamble", "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "9", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "preamble": null, "definition": null}

heading: Extension of periods
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "19", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "preamble": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "19", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "preamble": null, "definition": null}
